svg.title: Naev's map from its data files, with the three routes that are best for some landing cost
svg.desc: All 554 systems of Naev at their positions in the game's data, joined by their jumps; hidden jumps are dashed. Three routes are drawn thick: Dvaer Prime and Eist Shipyard, both in Dvaer; Burnan in Scarlet and Lora-Mor in Druss, one jump apart; and Modus in Modus Manis and Tankard Cloister in An'ku, two jumps apart by either of two paths.
svg.text: Dark dots: systems with a trading stop. Circled: the three systems with the highest betweenness. Dashed: hidden jumps.
